question: I have a list of byte ranges into a text that may overlap or repeat, and I need them merged into a sorted list of disjoint ranges. Is there already something in this repo for that?

A user gives me a dotted path into a nested JSON document, where a backslash before a dot means a literal dot in a key; I need it broken into its key segments. Is there already something in this repo for that?

Before adding a column to the document schema I want to check that the user-supplied column name is acceptable: non-empty and not starting with a dash. Is there already something in this repo for that?
I have two sets marking which documents of a segment are not deleted, and I need a set of the documents that are alive in both. Is there already something in this repo for that?

For a diagnostics endpoint I want a single human-readable line describing the library version, on-disk format version and the compression used for stored documents. Is there already something in this repo for that?

I need to turn a floating-point bound from a range query into the order-preserving unsigned integer encoding that the columnar storage uses for that column's type. Is there already something in this repo for that?

Inside a fixed-size block of 128 sorted document ids I need the position of the first id that is greater than or equal to a target, fast and without branches. Is there already something in this repo for that?
I need to combine several separate on-disk search indexes into one new index in a different directory. Is there already something in this repo for that?
After changing which segments make up the index, I need to persist the index metadata file atomically so a crash never leaves it half-written. Is there already something in this repo for that?

The internal key for nested JSON fields uses a special separator byte between path segments; for error messages I want to replace it in place with ordinary dots. Is there already something in this repo for that?
I need to compress a stored document block with LZ4 into a reusable output buffer. Is there already something in this repo for that?
Field lengths are stored as one byte each; I need to decode that one-byte code back into the approximate number of tokens in the field. Is there already something in this repo for that?
I need to parse a configuration value like '30s', '5m' or '2h' into a std::time::Duration. Is there already something in this repo for that?
I need to send an HTTP request to a remote node and retry it with exponential backoff on failure. Is there already something in this repo for that?

Users type patterns like `ab*cd` where the star stands for any run of characters; I need that turned into a regular expression with every other character matched literally. Is there already something in this repo for that?

To scan a sorted byte-keyed dictionary for everything starting with some bytes, I need the exclusive upper bound: the smallest key that sorts after all keys sharing that leading sequence (or nothing if there is none). Is there already something in this repo for that?

When planning an AND over several matching-document lists, I want a cheap guess of how many documents will match all of them, given only each list's length and the segment's document count. Is there already something in this repo for that?
I need the BM25 inverse document frequency for a term from its document frequency and the total number of documents. Is there already something in this repo for that?

For precise floating-point summation I want to add two doubles and get back both the rounded result and the exact low-order bits that rounding threw away, so they can be carried into later additions. Is there already something in this repo for that?

After sorting grouped results by how many documents each has, I need to keep only the first N groups and also report the count of the biggest group I dropped and the total documents across all dropped groups. Is there already something in this repo for that?

Each segment has its own sorted vocabulary; I want to walk the union of all of them in sorted order, seeing each distinct word once together with which segments contain it. Is there already something in this repo for that?
Categories form a tree like /electronics/phones; I need to test whether one category lies strictly beneath another one in that tree. Is there already something in this repo for that?
How many values do two ascending u32 slices share? Just the count, no allocation. Is there already something in this repo for that?

For search normalization I want accented and other non-English Latin letters replaced by their plain unaccented equivalents, so 'crème brûlée' matches 'creme brulee'. Is there already something in this repo for that?
Looking only at the leading byte of an encoded Unicode character, I need to know how many bytes the full character takes. Is there already something in this repo for that?

I want to pack an increasing list of u32 ids compactly by writing each difference from the previous value in 7-bit chunks, with a flag bit marking the final byte of each number. Is there already something in this repo for that?

German product names glue nouns together, e.g. 'dampfschifffahrt'; during indexing I want such words broken into their pieces using a list of known words, leaving them intact if they can't be fully decomposed. Is there already something in this repo for that?
When indexing emails, I want the analyzer to drop any token longer than a given number of bytes, like base64 attachment junk. Is there already something in this repo for that?

While streaming scored hits I want to retain the best K cheaply: let a buffer grow to about twice K, then trim it back and remember the worst kept score as a cutoff so weaker hits are rejected without inserting. Ties should go to the lower document id. Is there already something in this repo for that?

I need a shared, thread-safe auto-incrementing operation id generator that can also hand out a contiguous block of n ids in a single atomic step, and be rolled back to an earlier value. Is there already something in this repo for that?

I'd like to plug in my own per-segment cache that gets built whenever a fresh searcher is opened and whose entries are evicted once older searchers are no longer in use. Is there already something in this repo for that?

Analytics requests can blow up RAM; I need a budget shared across all per-segment workers of one request that fails the request once total allocation passes a cap, also limits how many groups get returned, and gives back its share automatically when a worker finishes. Is there already something in this repo for that?

I want to apply a fallible function to a batch of inputs either inline or on a worker pool, getting results back in input order and having worker panics surface in the caller. Is there already something in this repo for that?

I need a registry of closures to invoke whenever the index's metadata file changes, where each registration returns a token and the closure silently stops being called once that token is dropped. Is there already something in this repo for that?
I want to render a search result excerpt as HTML, escaping the text and wrapping the matched terms in highlight tags. Is there already something in this repo for that?

Every segment can tell me which columns it contains and their types; to show an index-wide schema overview I need those per-segment lists combined into one list, with duplicate name-and-type entries folded together. Is there already something in this repo for that?
In tests I need to assert that two floating-point scores are nearly equal, within a small tolerance, rather than exactly equal. Is there already something in this repo for that?
Writing tests, I'd like a terse inline way to build a record to index from `field => value` pairs instead of calling an add method per field. Is there already something in this repo for that?

When combining segments, I want to append the already-compressed blocks of an existing stored-document file onto a new one directly, skipping the decompress/recompress round trip. Is there already something in this repo for that?

Given a user-supplied path like `attributes.color.name`, I need to figure out which declared column it refers to, preferring the longest matching column name, and return the leftover nested path inside it. Is there already something in this repo for that?
I want to sort results by how far each document's latitude/longitude is from the user, using great-circle distance. Is there already something in this repo for that?
So that 'Smith' also matches 'Smyth', I want words reduced to a sound-alike code (Soundex or Metaphone style) during indexing. Is there already something in this repo for that?
I'd like to load a file of equivalent words (e.g. 'couch, sofa, settee') and have each query term expanded to all of its equivalents. Is there already something in this repo for that?
Our compliance team needs index files encrypted at rest, via a storage layer that transparently encrypts on write and decrypts on read. Is there already something in this repo for that?
